1: // Neon Escape – minimal endless runner
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // audio setup
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   const playBeep = (freq, duration) => {
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:     osc.type = 'sine';
13:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
15:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
16:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     osc.start();
18:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
19:   };
20:   // resume audio on first user interaction
21:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
22:   onkeydown = (e) => { resumeAudio(); keys[e.key] = true; };
23:   onkeyup = (e) => { keys[e.key] = false; };
24:   const resize = () => { canvas.width = innerWidth; canvas.height = innerHeight; };
25:   resize();
26:   addEventListener('resize', resize);
27: 
28:   const player = { x: innerWidth / 2, y: innerHeight - 40, radius: 12, speed: 5, boost: false };
29:   const keys = {};
30:   onkeydown = e => (keys[e.key] = true);
31:   onkeyup = e => (keys[e.key] = false);
32: 
33:   // tunnel slices: each slice = { y, left, right }
34:   const tunnel = [];
35:   const sliceHeight = 30;
36:   const baseWidth = innerWidth * 0.6;
37:   const amplitude = innerWidth * 0.2;
38:   let offset = 0;
39:   const genSlice = (y) => {
40:     const t = (y + offset) / 200;
41:     const center = innerWidth / 2 + Math.sin(t) * amplitude;
42:     const half = baseWidth / 2;
43:     return { y, left: center - half, right: center + half };
44:   };
45: 
46:   const initTunnel = () => {
47:     tunnel.length = 0;
48:     for (let y = 0; y < innerHeight; y += sliceHeight) tunnel.push(genSlice(y));
49:   };
50:   initTunnel();
51: 
52:   let last = 0, score = 0, speed = 2, running = true;
53:   const gameLoop = (t) => {
54:     if (!running) return;
55:     const delta = (t - last) / 16; // approx 60fps units
56:     last = t;
57:     // move tunnel up (player forward)
58:     tunnel.forEach(s => s.y -= speed * delta);
59:     // remove off‑screen slices and add new ones at bottom
60:     while (tunnel.length && tunnel[0].y < -sliceHeight) tunnel.shift();
61:     const lastY = tunnel[tunnel.length - 1]?.y || 0;
62:     while (lastY < innerHeight) {
63:       const newY = (tunnel[tunnel.length - 1]?.y || 0) + sliceHeight;
64:       tunnel.push(genSlice(newY));
65:     }
66:     // input
67:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.x -= (player.boost ? 2 : 1) * player.speed;
68:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.x += (player.boost ? 2 : 1) * player.speed;
69:     player.boost = keys[' '] || false;
70:     if (player.boost) playBeep(800, 0.12);
71:     // bounds
72:     const slice = tunnel.find(s => s.y + sliceHeight > player.y && s.y <= player.y);
73:     if (slice && (player.x - player.radius < slice.left || player.x + player.radius > slice.right)) {
74:       running = false; // crash
75:       playBeep(200, 0.3);
76:     }
77:     // keep player inside canvas
78:     player.x = Math.max(player.radius, Math.min(innerWidth - player.radius, player.x));
79:     // score & speed
80:     score += delta;
81:     speed = 2 + Math.floor(score / 5000) * 0.5;
82:     // draw enhanced graphics
83:     // background gradient
84:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
85:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001020');
86:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000030');
87:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
88:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
89: 
90:     // tunnel walls with neon glow
91:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.8)';
92:     ctx.lineWidth = 4;
93:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
94:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
95:     ctx.beginPath();
96:     tunnel.forEach((s, i) => {
97:       const prev = i === 0 ? s.left : tunnel[i - 1].left;
98:       ctx.moveTo(prev, s.y);
99:       ctx.lineTo(s.left, s.y + sliceHeight);
100:     });
101:     ctx.stroke();
102:     ctx.beginPath();
103:     tunnel.forEach((s, i) => {
104:       const prev = i === 0 ? s.right : tunnel[i - 1].right;
105:       ctx.moveTo(prev, s.y);
106:       ctx.lineTo(s.right, s.y + sliceHeight);
107:     });
108:     ctx.stroke();
109: 
110:     // optional: glowing particles (simple implementation)
111:     if (!window.__particles) window.__particles = [];
112:     const particles = window.__particles;
113:     // spawn particles near player when boosting
114:     if (player.boost) {
115:       for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
116:         particles.push({
117:           x: player.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20,
118:           y: player.y + player.radius,
119:           r: Math.random() * 3 + 2,
120:           vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
121:           vy: Math.random() * 1 + 0.5,
122:           life: 30
123:         });
124:       }
125:     }
126:     // update and draw particles
127:     ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
128:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.7)';
129:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
130:       const p = particles[i];
131:       p.x += p.vx;
132:       p.y += p.vy;
133:       p.life--;
134:       ctx.beginPath();
135:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:       ctx.fill();
137:       if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
138:     }
139:     ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
140:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
141: 
142:     // player with inner glow
143:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
144:     ctx.beginPath();
145:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
146:     ctx.fill();
147:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,0,0.6)';
148:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
149:     ctx.stroke();
150: 
151:     // UI
152:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
153:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
154:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 100), 10, 30);
155:     if (!running) {
156:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
157:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
158:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
159:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
160:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
161:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
162:     } else {
163:       requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
164:     }
165:   };
166:   requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
167: })();
